about: Cornish Wave is a Newquay surf school that has been teaching since 2012. Its base on Fore Street sits between Fistral and Towan, and lessons run on whichever of those two beaches suits the day's conditions. It also runs surf camps, retreats, coasteering, kayak and paddleboard tours.
offers: Private family lessons (ages 6+, up to 4 people)
Surf and adventure weekends and 4-night surf camps with camping
Coasteering, kayak tours, paddleboarding and Monster SUP
where: Base at 40 Fore St, Newquay TR7 1LP; lessons at Towan or Fistral depending on conditions
goodToKnow: Coaching, a C-Skins wetsuit, a board and a safety briefing are included
The base has heated changing rooms and hot showers
You need to be able to swim 25 metres and fill in a participation form
Instructors are described as Surfing England qualified and as trained beach lifeguards
gaps: No season or cancellation terms stated; the site's wording on instructor qualifications varies (Surfing England and ISA).
